projects.name: fractal-studio
projects.description: A React + TypeScript fractal studio for constructing, tinkering with, and rendering fractals in the browser. Includes a WebGPU renderer with WGSL shaders, a Canvas2D fallback, a complex-number formula engine with parser and differentiator, and ambient time/weather-driven palettes.

projects.name: MIND
projects.description: Research code and data for MIND: Multilingual Inconsistent Notion Detection, published at EMNLP 2025. Reproduces the paper's discrepancy-detection pipeline across multilingual QA, retrieval, and Wikipedia use cases.

projects.name: CV-agent
projects.description: A Mistral Workflows agent that searches the web for job openings matching a candidate CV, validates each fit, and emits a parsable CSV/JSON feed for a downstream agent. Re-verifies every source URL, then dedupes and ranks postings by match score.

projects.name: ClaudeBlock
projects.description: A browser-based Breakout roguelike ("BREAKER") built with vanilla JavaScript and Canvas. Runs 25 levels with boss and casino stages, relics, capsules, unlocks, and a tuned in-game economy.

projects.name: Logtimizer
projects.description: An AI-powered log analyzer with a dual interface: an MCP server for AI agents and a web dashboard for humans. Fetches logs from Azure, AWS, and GCP, prunes redundant lines by 60-80%, and uses an LLM to explain and summarize errors.

projects.name: Pic_utils
projects.description: A curated collection of Python tools for image processing, specifically tailored for artistic and creative purposes. Unlike standard image processing libraries, this toolkit focuses on creating textures, filters, and generative visual effects.

projects.name: TFG-LLMs
projects.description: Bachelor's Thesis research project exploring Large Language Models, their architectures, and applications in natural language processing tasks.

projects.name: Multi-download
projects.description: Bash & Python scripts for a simplified CLI downloading experience. Streamlines batch downloading with customizable options and progress tracking.

projects.name: Lagrange-Squares
projects.description: Mathematical and computational project implementing Lagrange polynomial interpolation and least squares fitting algorithms.
